The Subtask Name: Identify Randy Conrads' university affiliation
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed initial search results and decided to engage WebSurfer for targeted education searches.
  -- Observation: WebSurfer found Randy Conrads founded Classmates.com but no university link.
  -- Thought: Need to search specifically for education/university affiliation using variants.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search "Randy Conrads education" and related queries.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Executed search for "Randy Conrads education".
  -- Observation: Found a result from engineering.oregonstate.edu stating Randy Conrads received a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering from Oregon State University in 1972.
  -- Thought: This confirms the university affiliation.
  -- Result: Identified Oregon State University (OSU) as the related university.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 2
  to_step: 4
  source_agent: WebSurfer
  target_agent: Planner
  data_item: "University affiliation: Oregon State University (OSU)"
  data_type: text
  transformation: "extraction from search result snippet"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.95

The Subtask Name: Confirm OSU mascot identity with official sources
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer results showing OSU affiliation and Benny Beaver mentions, but noted lack of single explicit official citation.
  -- Observation: Multiple OSU-affiliated pages mention Benny Beaver as mascot, but no consolidated official page captured yet.
  -- Thought: Need to run more targeted searches on official OSU domains (osubeavers.com, oregonstate.edu) to get explicit confirmation.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search "Benny Beaver site:osubeavers.com" and related official queries.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Executed search for "Benny Beaver site:osubeavers.com" multiple times.
  -- Observation: Found results from osubeavers.com stating "Benny Beaver, while official accepted as the school's mascot in 1952..." and "Adopted as the official mascot in 1952, Benny Beaver still fires up the crowds...".
  -- Thought: These results from the official athletics site explicitly confirm Benny Beaver as the mascot.
  -- Result: Confirmed mascot is Benny Beaver with official OSU source citations.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 12
  to_step: 14
  source_agent: WebSurfer
  target_agent: Planner
  data_item: "Mascot confirmation: Benny Beaver (official OSU mascot)"

  transformation: "extraction from official athletics site search results"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.98
